scenarios.title: Split $100 USDC.e into YES/NO token pair
scenarios.event: User wants to create outcome tokens from USDC.e
scenarios.expectedAction: Approve USDC.e, call splitPosition, verify 100 YES + 100 NO tokens received

scenarios.title: Merge 50 YES + 50 NO tokens back to USDC.e
scenarios.event: User wants to convert token pair back to collateral
scenarios.expectedAction: Call mergePositions with equal amounts, verify $50 USDC.e returned

scenarios.title: Redeem winning YES tokens after market resolves YES
scenarios.event: Market resolved YES, user holds 100 YES tokens
scenarios.expectedAction: Call redeemPositions, verify $100 USDC.e received, NO tokens burned at $0

scenarios.title: Attempt to redeem before market resolution
scenarios.event: User tries to redeem tokens on unresolved market
scenarios.expectedAction: Detect market not resolved, reject operation with explanation

scenarios.title: Negative risk conversion between multi-outcome markets
scenarios.event: User holds NO on one outcome in a 3-way market
scenarios.expectedAction: Use Neg Risk Adapter to convert NO into YES across other outcomes

criteria: Split produces correct token amounts: Does the skill create equal YES/NO tokens from USDC.e?
Merge returns correct USDC.e: Does the skill convert equal token pairs back to collateral?
Redeem only works on resolved markets: Does the skill validate market resolution before redemption?
Correct contracts used for neg risk vs standard: Does the skill use the right exchange contracts?
Approvals set for correct contracts: Does the skill approve the right spender for each operation?
